messages:
Jordan (ENG-MGR): quick Q: planning to bump Omar to L4 with comp raise. goal effective 05/01. what are the deadlines and forms?
Maya (People Ops): hi! to hit a 05/01 HRIS effective date we need the completed promo packet + signed comp-change by the payroll cutoff two weeks before the pay run. concrete dates depend on the upcoming payroll calendar.
Jordan (ENG-MGR): can you list the exact items you need in the packet?
Maya (People Ops): sure 1 items: manager rationale (3 bullets), role profile, two concrete contribution examples (links + short context), at least one peer feedback quote, proposed comp breakdown (base, bonus %), PeopleSoft ID, and requested effective date. also include manager signature.
Jordan (ENG-MGR): is there a template?
hr-bot: Promo packet template: https://redwood.example.com/internal/promo-template. Use file name format: promo_<EMP>_<mgr>.pdf
Jordan (ENG-MGR): thanks. if we miss the payroll cutoff can we still record the level change on 05/01 but pay later?
Nina (Payroll): yes. title/level can be backdated in HRIS to 05/01, but retroactive pay requires payroll submission before cutoff. late submissions carry pay to the next payroll cycle.
Devon (Director ENG): do we require calibration sign-off for salaries above midpoint?
Liam (Compensation): anything above band midpoint should be documented with justification in the packet. if proposed base > band max we need a comp exception form and approval from the comp committee. please CC compensation on the packet.
Jordan (ENG-MGR): how do we handle equity timing - can grants be aligned with promo?
Maya (People Ops): equity is separate. submit the grants request after comp approval. equity cycles have their own timelines and legal sign-offs. comp approval helps prioritize the grant.
Jordan (ENG-MGR): what's the best evidence for promotion impact?
Maya (People Ops): short measurable stuff: metrics improved, PRs with code ownership, cross-team coordination, customer-facing wins. paste 2-3 bullet lines per contribution and link. no giant PDFs please.
Jordan (ENG-MGR): manager announcement: can I tell Omar in a 1:1 before People Ops finishes payroll?
Maya (People Ops): managers can do a private 1:1 heads-up, but public/team announcements should wait until People Ops confirms HRIS + payroll sync to avoid confusion.
Nina (Payroll): one operational ask: include employee DOB and PeopleSoft ID to avoid duplicates.
Liam (Compensation): add to that: if comp moves to a different band, include suggested band movement and rationale.
Jordan (ENG-MGR): timing for calibration meetings?
Maya (People Ops): engineering calibration is every Tuesday 10am this month. drop the packet in the "Calibration Review" folder by Friday EOD to be added.
Jordan (ENG-MGR): any preferred format for peer feedback?
Maya (People Ops): a short quoted sentence with author and context works best, e.g., "Led design for X, cleared blockers" - Priya.
Devon (Director ENG): if promotion is part of a team transfer (Omar moving from infra to platform), any extra steps?
Maya (People Ops): yes: include both managers' approvals and the transfer ticket ID. tick the "transfer + promo" checkbox on the form.
Jordan (ENG-MGR): can we do a mid-cycle comp increase outside promo window?
Liam (Compensation): mid-cycle adjustments are allowed but need stronger justification and typically exec approval. use the "mid-cycle comp" workflow and expect longer lead time.
Jordan (ENG-MGR): thanks. i'll assemble and ping if i need a pre-check.
Maya (People Ops): please ping me 24-48 hours before submission if you want a quick sanity check. checklist below for copy/paste.
Maya (People Ops): ```
- Promo packet (template)
- Manager rationale (3 bullets)
- 2 contribution examples (links + 2-line context)
- Peer feedback excerpt
- Proposed comp (base, bonus %)
- PeopleSoft ID and DOB
- Manager signature and both manager approvals if transfer
- Comp-exception note if > band max
```
Jordan (ENG-MGR): copying checklist. submitting by Friday. thanks all.
Maya (People Ops): thanks 1 closing here.
hr-bot: Reminder: do not post public announcements until People Ops confirms payroll.
